[red bold]-- TYPE MISMATCH -- type_mismatch_assign.volt:4[/red bold]

Variable `x` declared as `int` but assigned `string`.

 [dim]3 |[/dim] setup {
 [dim]4 |[/dim]     var x: int = "hello"
 [dim]  |[/dim] [red]        ^[/red]

[cyan]Hint: Change the type to `string` or convert the value with `int(value)`.[/cyan]
